last_change.summary: Published the admitted experiment trial-plan contract: the immutable, schedule-independent handoff between experiment design/admission and orchestration (SCE-002/SCE-006, ADR-084, issue #788). Profiles and admission state are closed literals in the published schema, apparatus manifests are digest-pinned, stochastic draws join their entry coordinate, values duplicated from incumbent authorities (random-stream profile, binding condition/family) must agree, and bounded parallelism requires resource-disjoint entries.
